0d002b599c4544c7475bc4787adafa79baa8a0b8.why: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids and crusty plaques on the eyelid margins were specific findings for Blepharitis.

1814e52ed395fb3255c6706a244ef3968eafa6ab.why: The presence of an enhanced left-adrenal heterogeneous mass on the contrast-enhanced abdominal CT, along with elevated troponin and white blood cell count, decided it.

3208f868de1a29121ba403cb9e03d4b03f885ac5.why: The presence of milia and erosions with partially detached epidermis specifically supports Lichen Sclerosus.

35a99a956768947082a250d96c909895bebe5ccb.why: The presence of emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye and en face swept source OCT showing oil bubbles within its boundaries specifically supports Silicone oil-induced retinal toxicity.

510c05defa4e160cddee770fafd477a521dc65d5.why: The presence of symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal joints and interphalangeal joints, along with dorsal MCP ulcers, specifically supports Amyopathic Dermatomyositis, despite normal muscle strength.

5249d01bbc1abd0dd7c3102bf87df83693e793e1.why: The presence of 3 well-circumscribed, violaceous, annular patches without scale or erosion that are limited to his right axilla and lymphocytes obscuring the dermal-epidermal junction are specific findings that support Granuloma annulare.

56c249c0755aa8e90517f15554a1c50b05bf331c.why: The presence of serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies and PVB19 DNA in the lesional skin biopsy specimen decided it

5c31dbe6f87018705a2f8bed0f8e9752255abeee.why: Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67, specifically support Chondrosarcoma.

64e55beb3d3ea5964daadb9704223ddb4b77bd4a.why: The evidence of Fontan circulation and the absence of intracardiac thrombus detected, along with the specific ECG findings, decided it.

83d7cf1a1469144fd975002fa3a89b74ec40fc2b.why: The presence of specific skin symptoms such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles, which are characteristic of dermatomyositis, decided it.

88edd76c4ed4e4ec609cc7329b8dee62fea6ec26.why: Myeloperoxidase-positive cells and a 10-year history of IgG-κ multiple myeloma specifically support Leukemia Cutis.

8e404c260087e14d53b82e65177af494235559da.why: The presence of subepidermal blisters with apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining, a hallmark of amyloid deposits, decided it.

cf84dbdc531b40ca24b3d0763da2a4ee738d236f.why: The presence of malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, along with mitotic figures, decided it.

e09ad0d43ca9a6f9e390afe8e4d1d610d7766405.why: The histopathology revealing a multinodular proliferation of osteoclastlike multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells demonstrating increased mitotic activity, along with positive immunohistochemistry for CD68, specifically supports this diagnosis.

fc320476196a8f5df9938ce2ea7b1b434793f677.why: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody and thick exudate in subarachnoid space specifically support Rheumatoid Meningitis.
